name: The Helpful Config Loader
description:
The appconfig-tools package shipped a quiet patch adding “encrypted config loading” to utils/config_helper.py. Your SOC flagged it. There is no literal os.system or eval in the file — the sink is built indirectly and the trigger hides behind a magic byte marker.

Recover the marker that flips a config blob into a command, and the exec sink the helpers assemble. Submit HXN{<magic_marker_hex>_<decoded_exec_sink>}.
hints: Follow the decrypt path. When the recovered plaintext starts a certain way, the rest stops being config — and the sink's name is built out of Base64 pieces.
